review_candidates.title: Head of Wireless Delivery
review_candidates.description: Position OverviewWe are looking for a Head of Wireless Delivery with experience in managing complex wireless infrastructure programmes and building a scalable construction organisation in Manchester. Job location: United Kingdom, Manchester, Greater Manchester Available Positions: 1 position Job type: Permanent Job Ref. Number: HOWDL02.10.26 Description Overview The Head of Wireless Delivery leads the successful construction and build delivery of wireless infrastructure programmes across the UK. The role is accountable for establishing and managing Connect44’s construction operating model, using internal build leadership together with dedicated build partners and specialist subcontractors to provide safe, scalable and commercially controlled delivery. The role oversees construction from approved handover-to-build and site readiness through mobilisation, civils, rigging, electrical works, equipment installation, integration support, quality assurance, handover, commercial completion and final account. The position is solely focused on construction and build responsibilities, while coordinating the interfaces required from design, acquisition, commercial, HSEQ, logistics and the client to enable build delivery. Key Responsibilities Own the UK wireless construction and build delivery strategy, governance, operating model and performance across all awarded build programmes. Lead the build function from approved handover-to-build through construction readiness, mobilisation, site execution, integration support, handover, defect closure and commercial completion. Develop, maintain and scale the partnership model comprising Connect44 build leadership, dedicated civils, rigging and electrical partners, and specialist subcontractors required for scaffolding, DNO management, structural fabrication and other project-specific works. Ensure partner capacity is aligned to forecast site volumes, regional demand, site type, competence requirements and client delivery priorities, with dedicated field teams allocated where required. Set clear scopes, work instructions, deliverables, service levels, reporting requirements and accountability for internal staff and every build partner and subcontractor. Lead the allocation of construction work based on competence, capacity, geography, safety, quality, programme performance, commercial position and client requirements. Maintain effective partner governance through mobilisation reviews, weekly operational meetings, performance reviews, recovery plans and direct intervention where delivery is at risk. Build and lead the internal construction delivery team, including Build Managers, dependency management, project coordination, site supervision, assurance and handover support. Develop the internal team and partner organisation to provide resilient national delivery capacity and support mobilisation, volume increases and specialist construction requirements. Lead construction mobilisation for new clients and projects, confirming scope, delivery methodology, resource plans, partner allocations, systems, compliance, reporting and commercial controls before delivery starts. Oversee delivery across rooftop, tower, streetworks, greenfield and compound environments, including civils, foundations, steelwork, structural modifications, rigging, electrical, power, transmission and equipment installation. Ensure all construction activity follows approved designs, client specifications, work instructions and controlled change processes, preventing unauthorised site-led changes. Act as the senior construction escalation point for site blockers, access issues, outages, materials, plant, DNO, design clarifications, safety, quality and partner performance. Ensure Sitetracker and client systems provide a reliable build record, with partners updating instructions, milestones, dependencies and evidence directly where required. Use dashboards, milestone checks and accountability tracking to identify missing data, orphaned activities, overdue actions and risks to forecast completion. Lead regular construction progress reviews covering design approved for build, pre-start, materials, DNO, RAMS and welfare, access, outages, plant, civils, rigging, electrical, integration, handover, audits and revisits. Drive recovery where sites are behind plan through reprioritisation, resequencing, additional resources, alternative partners, escalation and targeted action plans. Provide senior construction leadership under CDM 2015 and ensure Connect44 fulfils its appointed Principal Contractor or Contractor responsibilities for the construction phase. Challenge cost leakage, abortive works, repeat visits, unapproved changes, idle resources, partner overspend and incomplete evidence that delays invoicing. Manage and maintain accurate construction forecasts linking physical site progress, milestone completion, value, revenue recognition, GRN and invoicing expectations. Represent Connect44 in client build reviews, programme governance, partner meetings, site escalations and construction performance forums. Support construction bids, PQQs, client presentations and pricing reviews with build methodology, delivery structures, partnership capacity, resource models, programme assumptions, risk inputs and mobilisation plans. Drive continuous improvement in construction delivery through lessons learned, standard work, automation, dashboarding, partner development and removal of non-value-adding administration. Skills And Experience Extensive senior experience leading wireless telecoms construction and build programmes, ideally across 4G and 5G network deployment. Proven ability to establish, mobilise and manage a blended delivery organisation using internal Build Managers, dedicated delivery partners and specialist subcontractors. Strong knowledge of telecoms construction across towers, rooftops, streetworks, greenfield sites and compounds. Excellent technical understanding of telecoms civils, steelwork, structural modifications, rigging, electrical systems, power, DNO, transmission and equipment installation. Proven experience managing geographically dispersed construction portfolios and multiple concurrent sites, clients and partners. Strong knowledge of CDM 2015 construction-phase duties, Principal Contractor responsibilities, contractor assurance, temporary works, permitting and site safety controls. Demonstrable experience managing build partners against capacity, competence, safety, quality, programme, cost, reporting and behavioural expectations. Must possess exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to articulate results, flag issues, and resolve complex problems directly with internal and external director-level stakeholders. Ability to interpret approved designs, scopes, drawings, rigging and electrical information and convert them into controlled construction delivery plans. Strong commercial and financial understanding of tenders, quotations, rate cards, partner pricing, variations, change control, purchase orders, margin, WIP, GRN, invoicing and final accounts. Advanced programme, reporting and data-management skills, including Excel, dashboards, Sitetracker or comparable delivery platforms. Excellent client, partner and supplier management skills, with the ability to negotiate, challenge, escalate and agree recovery actions. Proven ability to create structure, accountability and clear decision-making within high-volume and delivery-pressured construction environments. Clear and collaborative leadership style, with the confidence to hold internal teams and external partners accountable for construction outcomes. Qualifications Relevant degree, HNC/HND, apprenticeship or equivalent demonstrable experience in telecommunications, construction, engineering or project delivery, preferred but not essential. Valid Health & Safety qualification such as SMSTS, NEBOSH or IOSH Managing Safely is highly required. Basic CDM 2015 training covering duties applicable to Principal Designer and Contractor. Rooftop access, Radio Frequency awareness and First Aid at Work certification appropriate to the leadership remit are desirable. Project, programme or commercial management qualifications are advantageous. Full UK driving licence and ability to travel nationally as required.

review_candidates.description: Position Summary The General Counsel is a business partner to the President and executive team. Reporting to the President, this role leads legal strategy for real estate acquisitions, development, and financing, with a strong emphasis on structuring, negotiating, and documenting complex transactions. The General Counsel also oversees employment and labor matters across a multi-entity hospitality, gaming, and development portfolio, manages outside counsel, and protects the company from legal, regulatory, and contractual risk. Essential Duties And Responsibilities Real Estate Transactions & Financing Lead the legal side of acquisitions, dispositions, joint ventures, and development pro-jects from term sheet through closing. Structure, negotiate, and document construction loans, acquisition financing, mezzanine and preferred equity, refinancings, and loan modifications. Draft and negotiate purchase and sale agreements, loan agreements, guaranties, inter-creditor agreements, JV and operating agreements, and ground and commercial leases. Oversee due diligence, title and survey review, zoning and entitlements, and closing documentation. Manage lender, investor, and partner relationships on legal matters, including compliance with loan covenants and reporting requirements. Development & Construction Draft and negotiate construction contracts, architect and design agreements, development agreements, and consultant contracts. Advise on construction risk, change orders, payment disputes, liens, bonding, insurance, and warranty claims. Support the in-house construction company on contract administration, subcontractor agreements, and dispute resolution. Coordinate with municipalities and regulators on permitting, licensing, and land-use matters. Employment & Labor Advise Human Resources and leadership on employment law compliance, including wage and hour, leave, discrimination, harassment, and accommodation. Guide investigations, terminations, severance and separation agreements, and restrictive covenants. Manage employment-related claims, agency charges, and litigation with outside counsel. Review and update employee handbooks, policies, and employment agreements across all entities. Advise on WARN Act notices, reductions in force, and other workforce actions. Corporate, Governance & Risk Maintain corporate records and entity structures across the portfolio; support formation of new project entities. Draft and review commercial contracts, vendor agreements, NDAs, and hospitality management agreements. Identify legal and regulatory risks, including gaming and hospitality licensing, and recommend practical solutions. Legal Department Leadership Oversee litigation strategy and manage outside counsel, budgets, and results. Build and lead the legal function, including any future legal staff. Serve as a trusted advisor to ownership and senior leadership on legal matters affecting the business. Qualifications Juris Doctor from an accredited law school. Active membership in the Florida Bar, or eligibility and willingness to obtain it (including Authorized House Counsel certification). 12+ years of legal experience, with significant time at a top-tier law firm and/or in-house with a real estate developer, owner, or investor. Deep experience structuring, negotiating, and documenting real estate financing trans-actions, including construction and acquisition loans, mezzanine debt, and joint venture equity. Strong drafting skills and command of complex transaction documentation from term sheet through closing. Working knowledge of employment and labor law and experience advising management on workforce matters. Proven ability to manage outside counsel and legal budgets. Preferred Construction law experience, including AIA and ConsensusDocs contracts, construction claims, and lien matters. Experience with luxury hospitality, mixed-use, or condominium development projects. Exposure to gaming, hospitality, or liquor licensing and regulatory compliance. Prior experience as General Counsel or Deputy General Counsel of a privately held company. Admission in Nevada or other states where the company operates. Key Competencies Commercial judgment: practical, deal-focused advice that moves transactions forward while managing risk. Executive presence and clear, direct communication with ownership and senior leadership. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with multiple active projects and tight deadlines. Discretion and integrity when handling highly confidential business and personnel matters.

And importantly, we are not raising money to build an idea or an MVP. The marketplace is already operating. Where we are today: 374 active merchants 170 registered users 75 completed transactions ₦300K+ Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) transacted Approximately 25% of purchasing customers have already made repeat purchases across different categories Built so far without institutional investment or paid customer acquisition That last behaviour is particularly interesting to us. That is the ecosystem we want to build. The purpose of this round is very specific: Prove the growth engine. The capital will primarily help us accelerate customer acquisition, improve conversion and analytics, strengthen the marketplace selectively, and build repeatable demand in our initial market. Our expansion philosophy is simple: Density before geography. Trust before scale. Prove the model in Abuja → replicate selectively across Nigeria → expand into carefully chosen African markets. We believe Africa presents a significant opportunity for a trusted, curated platform sitting at the intersection of commerce, hospitality, entertainment and experiences. Founder capital built the marketplace. Angel capital will help prove the growth engine. Future capital can scale a proven model across Africa. We are particularly interested in speaking with angel investors, Africa-focused investors, marketplace/technology investors, hospitality and travel investors, and strategic investors who can bring not only capital, but perspective, networks and experience. If this thesis resonates with you, please send me a direct message. I would be happy to share our investor deck and have a conversation. Charles@boseatsafrica.com Whatsapp +2349033157301

review_candidates.description: The role will support projects across Central and Southern Luzon , with current and anticipated project locations including Zambales, Subic Bay, Clark/Pampanga and surrounding areas . The successful candidate must be willing and able to travel regularly between project sites and, where required, remain on-site for periods appropriate to the project schedule. Sadath Business Group (SBG) is seeking an experienced Construction Project Manager to support a growing pipeline of construction, infrastructure and facility upgrade projects, primarily involving United States Government (USG), Department of Defense (DoD) and defence-sector clients . The successful candidate will be responsible for managing projects from post-award planning and design coordination through procurement, construction, commissioning and final handover . Projects may include design-build facilities, industrial and maintenance buildings, civil and utility infrastructure, structural works, electrical and mechanical systems, HVAC, fire and life-safety systems, facility renovations and containerised/modular facilities. Key Responsibilities Manage construction projects from contract award through design, mobilisation, construction, commissioning, handover and close-out. Develop and maintain detailed project execution plans, construction programs, CPM schedules, short-term look-ahead schedules, procurement schedules and milestone trackers . Coordinate architects, engineers, Designers of Record, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers and internal project personnel. Review Statements of Work, drawings, specifications, BOQs, design calculations and contractual requirements to ensure the project team understands the complete scope. Manage design development and the submission/approval process, including drawings, calculations, material submittals, shop drawings, RFIs and technical documentation. Lead procurement planning and coordinate long-lead materials, equipment, subcontractors and logistics. Manage subcontractor performance, including scope, schedule, quality, safety, progress and commercial obligations. Monitor project budgets, committed costs, forecasts, variations, progress claims and overall cost-to-complete. Identify project risks, schedule constraints and potential cost impacts early and implement appropriate mitigation and recovery plans. Lead coordination meetings, progress meetings, technical meetings and client meetings and maintain clear action registers and project records. Ensure construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, applicable codes, permits and contract requirements. Work closely with dedicated Quality Control, Site Safety and Superintendent personnel to maintain compliant project execution. Coordinate inspections, testing, commissioning, punch-list activities and corrective works. Maintain accurate progress reporting, including schedules, RFIs, submittal registers, procurement status, subcontractor progress, photographs and management reporting. Manage project changes and ensure potential scope, cost and schedule impacts are identified, documented and communicated before work proceeds. Coordinate with Government/client representatives, including Contracting Officer Representatives and other authorised stakeholders where applicable. Ensure completion of as-built drawings, O&M manuals, warranties, testing records, training requirements and final turnover documentation. That reporting discipline is particularly important for these projects: the NAVFAC requirements call for updated schedules, RFI/submittal registers, labour/equipment/material reporting, safety and QC reporting and weekly progress documentation. The V2X SOWs also expect the PM function to maintain visibility of project status, problems, risks, mitigation plans and lower-tier subcontractor performance. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Building Construction or a related discipline . Approximately 7+ years of construction/project management experience , preferably including commercial, industrial, institutional, infrastructure or defence projects. Demonstrated experience managing design-build projects and multidisciplinary construction packages. Strong understanding of civil, structural, architectural and MEP construction interfaces. Experience managing subcontractors, suppliers, consultants and multidisciplinary engineering teams. Strong construction scheduling skills, including critical path, sequencing, procurement and look-ahead planning. Experience with project cost control, forecasting, variations/change management and progress claims. Strong understanding of QA/QC procedures, inspections, testing, commissioning and project close-out. Strong written and spoken English with the ability to prepare professional correspondence, reports and project documentation. Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, BOQs, contracts and technical requirements. Competency with Microsoft Project and/or Primavera P6 , Microsoft Excel and standard construction/project management systems. Willingness to work at project sites and travel as required. Highly Desirable Previous experience delivering US Government, US DoD, NAVFAC, USACE, LOGCAP or other defence/international government construction projects . Familiarity with UFC, UFGS, NFPA, NEC and other US Government construction requirements . Familiarity with EM 385-1-1 , Accident Prevention Plans and Activity Hazard Analyses. Experience dealing with Government representatives, formal submittal processes, RFIs, change control and contract documentation. Knowledge of FAR-based fixed-price construction contracts . Experience managing projects in the Philippines or elsewhere in the Asia-Pacific region. Previous experience with industrial facilities, workshops, warehouses, maintenance facilities, utilities or defence infrastructure. Experience coordinating professionally signed/sealed engineering designs and local permitting requirements. The EM 385 point is worth including because NAVFAC specifically requires EM 385-1-1 compliance, project-specific Accident Prevention Plans and AHAs, while placing separate responsibilities on the SSHO and QC personnel. I would not , however, require the Project Manager themselves to be the SSHO or QCM; your documents specifically contemplate dedicated superintendent, QC and safety functions on these projects. What We're Looking For We are looking for someone who can take ownership of a project rather than simply supervise site activities. The successful candidate should be capable of understanding the contract, coordinating the design team, controlling the program and budget, managing subcontractors, anticipating problems and maintaining the documentation required to successfully deliver projects in a Government contracting environment. They must be comfortable working across both the technical and commercial sides of construction and communicating effectively with engineers, site personnel, subcontractors, suppliers, management and client representatives.

review_candidates.title: Construction Coordinator
review_candidates.description: Job Description ITG Communications is hiring for Construction Coordinator (Remote, US). The Construction Coordinator is responsible for planning, coordinating, and monitoring construction projects from initiation through completion. This role ensures that projects are executed in alignment with company standards, client requirements, and budget expectations. The Construction Coordinator serves as the central point of coordination between field operations, subcontractors, internal departments, and external stakeholders. This role drives project execution, supports cost control, and ensures timely delivery of construction activities across multiple projects. Responsibilities Key Responsibilities: Coordinate all phases of construction projects including pre-construction, permitting, design, material procurement, construction, and closeout Support planning of workflows, schedules, and resource allocation Ensure projects are executed in accordance with established standards and timelines Monitor project progress and proactively address delays or issues Develop and support cost estimates for construction projects Monitor job costs and track work-in-progress against budget Review and evaluate change orders for accuracy and financial impact Support cost control efforts to ensure project profitability Conduct site walkouts and ride-outs to assess project conditions, gather data, and monitor progress Perform post-construction reviews to ensure quality and completion standards are met Identify field issues and collaborate on solutions with internal teams and contractors Coordinate and oversee subcontractors and construction crews Monitor contractor performance against project goals, timelines, and quality standards Ensure proper resource allocation including labor, materials, and equipment Partner with internal teams including Finance, Procurement, Warehouse, Legal, Engineering, and Design Provide technical input and construction support to cross-functional stakeholders Communicate project status, risks, and updates to leadership and relevant teams Coordinate permit applications, licensing, and make-ready processes Interface with municipalities, utility companies, and regulatory agencies Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal requirements Maintain project logs, reports, and documentation related to construction activities, materials, and expenditures Track project milestones and provide status updates to management Ensure accurate and timely reporting of project data Review and respond to customer requests and complaints related to construction activities Ensure timely resolution and maintain customer satisfaction Key Measures / Key Performance Indicators On-time project completion Budget adherence and cost control Quality of construction and post-build outcomes Contractor and crew performance Accuracy and timeliness of project reporting Reduction in rework and field issues Customer satisfaction and issue resolution Requirements Education: High school diploma or equivalent required Experience 2–5 years of experience in cable/telecom construction (fiber and coax preferred) 2–5 years of experience in project coordination or supervisory roles preferred Exposure Full construction lifecycle (design through closeout) Telecom infrastructure deployment (aerial and underground) Budgeting, cost tracking, and financial coordination Contractor and vendor management Regulatory and permitting processes Factors critical to success at ITG Communications for this position: Strong coordination and organizational skills Ability to balance field operations with administrative responsibilities Accountability for project timelines and outcomes Effective cross-functional communication Proactive problem-solving and decision-making Physical Requirements Ability to lift up to 50 pounds Valid driver’s license and clean driving record Ability to travel to job sites and perform field inspections Ability to work flexible schedules, including nights, weekends, and overtime as needed Additional Comments ITG is an equal employment opportunity employer. ITG’s policy is not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age (40 and over), disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. ITG also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also ITG’s policy to comply with all applicable federal, state and local laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions.

Actualmente nos encontramos en búsqueda de un "TÉCNICO DE FILTRADO DE ACCESORIOS" . ¿Quieres formar parte de este entorno sólido, de ritmo acelerado, donde tus posibilidades de crecer son infinitas? Te explicamos… ¿Cuáles van a ser tus funciones? Realizar el filtrado, revisión y clasificación de accesorios utilizados en terminales POS. Verificar el estado y las condiciones de cables, fuentes de alimentación y demás accesorios de los equipos POS. Identificar accesorios que presenten fallas, deterioro o no cumplan con las condiciones requeridas para su uso. Realizar el conteo, registro y control de cables, fuentes y accesorios POS. Organizar y mantener correctamente clasificados los accesorios en el almacén. Gestionar la disponibilidad de los componentes para su distribución o reposición en inventario. Apoyar en las actividades de mantenimiento y reparación de equipos POS, según las necesidades operativas. Cualquier otro tipo de tareas accesorias y complementarias a las anteriores. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? Sueldo mayor al mercado. Pagos PUNTUALES. PLANILLA COMPLETA desde el primer día (CTS, gratificación, asignación familiar, vacaciones, entre otros). Experiencia mínima de 6 meses en filtrado, revisión, mantenimiento de equipos electrónicos, accesorios, almacén o funciones similares. Disponibilidad para laborar de manera presencial en nuestra sede de Surco. Si tienes ganas de aprender y crecer profesionalmente, si eres una persona responsable, detallista y orientada al cumplimiento de objetivos, si te gusta trabajar en equipo… ¡Esta es tu oportunidad! Ven a formar parte de Necomplus. ¡Te estamos esperando! #joinus #wearehiring
